title: Freezer Peach Pie Filling
description: Make this freezer peach pie filling recipe by tossing the fruit with sugar, cornstarch, tapioca, then freezing it in a pie plate so it's ready when needed.

steps.text: Line a 9-inch pie plate with aluminum foil. Set aside.

Sprinkle sliced peaches with sugar, cornstarch, tapioca, and nutmeg in a large bowl; toss until evenly coated and sugar is mostly dissolved. Transfer peach filling to the prepared pie plate; cover with a piece of aluminum foil and immediately freeze to prevent peaches from discoloring.
Once frozen solid, remove filling using the bottom foil; transfer to a resealable plastic freezer bag. Freeze until ready to use.
Preheat the oven to 450 degrees F (230 degrees C) with rack in bottom position.
Line a 9-inch pie plate with pie crust; place frozen peach filling on top.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes. Reduce the oven temperature to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C); continue baking until completely warmed through and filling is bubbly, 30 to 35 minutes more.
